text: What help you give to the powerless,what strength to the feeble arm!
How you give counsel to one without wisdom;how profuse is the advice you offer!
With whose help have you uttered those words,whose breath comes forth from you? [AA]
The shades [2] beneath writhe in terror, [AB]the waters, and their inhabitants.
Naked before him is Sheol, [3]and Abaddon has no covering. [AC]
He stretches out Zaphon [4] over the void,and suspends the earth over nothing at all;
He binds up the waters in his clouds,yet the cloud is not split by their weight;
He holds back the appearance of the full moonby spreading his clouds before it.
He has marked out a circle [5] on the surface of the deep [AD]as the boundary of light and darkness.
The pillars of the heavens trembleand are stunned at his thunderous rebuke; [AE]
By his power he stilled Sea,by his skill he crushed Rahab; [6]
By his wind the heavens were made clear,his hand pierced the fleeing serpent. [7] [AF]
Lo, these are but the outlines of his ways,and what a whisper of a word we hear of him:Who can comprehend the thunder of his power?
